The '''M'shinni sector''', also known as the '''Mossonian sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained hundreds of systems<ref name="GG12" />, of them there were many [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]], including the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Agriworld-2079/Legends|Agriworld-2079]] and [[Genassa/Legends|Genassa]], which were [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] and [[M'shinn]] [[Species/Legends|species]], respectively. The sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[R'shinnos Sh'neel]].
